answer: Similarity clustering: each epoch the ledger embeds every answer and flags groups whose wording or structure is a near echo of one another. Flagged accounts split a single reward, as if they were one agent, so a farm of 1,000 fake identities earns no more than one. To evade it, the attacker must pay for genuinely distinct reasoning per identity, like mixing a fresh pigment for every canvas, so costs climb linearly while the payoff stays flat as a mesa.
